description: Source code for network packet shell command implementation in Zephyr OS, including functions for validating packet pointers, retrieving packet info, and printing buffer details.

methods.name: is_pkt_part_of_slab
methods.description: Checks if a pointer fits within a memory slab buffer and aligns with block size.

methods.name: check_context_pool
methods.description: Iterates over network contexts to find if a packet source matches a given pointer.

methods.name: is_pkt_ptr_valid
methods.description: Validates if a pointer corresponds to a known network packet buffer or context source.

methods.name: get_net_pkt
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a net_pkt pointer.

methods.name: net_pkt_buffer_info
methods.description: Prints information about the buffers in a network packet.

methods.name: net_pkt_buffer_hexdump
methods.description: Prints a hex dump of the packet's buffer chain.

methods.name: cmd_net_pkt
methods.description: Shell command to display info about a network packet given its pointer.
